sub_graphs.description: Models how beacon chain block roots are stored in the EVM via a system call at the start of each block

nodes.description: Read the parent_beacon_block_root from the block header

nodes.label: Compute Ring Buffer Index
nodes.description: Calculate storage index as timestamp % HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH (8191)

nodes.label: Execute System Call to Beacon Roots Contract
nodes.description: Make system call from SYSTEM_ADDRESS to BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS with parent beacon root as calldata

nodes.label: Store Timestamp at Index
nodes.description: Write block timestamp to storage slot at computed index

nodes.label: Store Beacon Root at Offset Index
nodes.description: Write beacon root to storage slot at index + HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH

nodes.label: Beacon Root Stored Successfully
nodes.description: Parent beacon block root is now available for EVM queries

nodes.label: Validate Timestamp Match
nodes.description: Compare queried timestamp with stored timestamp to prevent stale data

nodes.label: Load Beacon Root
nodes.description: Read beacon root from index + HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH

ambiguities.text: The specification states validity is 'guaranteed from the consensus layer' without defining what happens if a malicious CL root is somehow included
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the execution layer unconditionally trusts the consensus layer. If CL is compromised, EL inherits that compromise. This is a fundamental trust assumption of the merged architecture.

ambiguities.text: Behavior when querying timestamps from before the fork activation (FORK_TIMESTAMP) is not explicitly defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume queries for pre-fork timestamps will fail the timestamp match validation since no data was stored before activation.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'silent failure if no code exists at beacon roots address' does not specify exact state changes
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume silent failure means the call returns without error but has no effect, similar to a call to an empty account. Block processing continues normally.

implicit_assumptions.description: The consensus layer provides correct and authentic beacon block roots
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Corrupted or forged beacon roots could be used for fraudulent proofs, potentially enabling theft from bridges or other CL-dependent protocols

implicit_assumptions.description: Block timestamps are monotonically increasing and reasonably accurate
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timestamp manipulation could cause ring buffer collisions, allowing attackers to overwrite recent beacon roots with stale ones

implicit_assumptions.description: The beacon roots contract at BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS is correctly deployed with the specified bytecode
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing or incorrect contract would cause silent failures, breaking all beacon root dependent functionality

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot produce valid execution blocks without corresponding consensus layer blocks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could inject arbitrary beacon roots into the EVM, bypassing CL validation entirely
